sources.degrees: KUCCPS institution page for MMU (code 1164), fetched 24 Sep 2026: https://students.kuccps.net/institutions/1164/
sources.costs: Education News Hub, 'KUCCPS final course list for Multimedia University' (Year 1 programme cost). Secondary source; check against MMU's official fee structures (https://www.mmu.ac.ke/fee-structure/) before billing.
sources.units: MMU e-learning course catalogue, fetched 24 Sep 2026: https://elearning.mmu.ac.ke/course/index.php (only units that carry a code; a small part of the full catalogue)

notes: Faculty and department names are MMU's own. Department codes other than ECE, MME and CE are abbreviations made up for this data set.
Which department runs each programme is inferred from the programme and department names; confirm with the registry.
Credit hours were not published with the units; 3 is used for all of them until corrected.
Durations: 5 years for engineering degrees, 4 for other degrees, 3 for diplomas (typical for Kenyan public universities; confirm per programme).
